# Security policy

Report vulnerabilities in Voxland through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Rhinomcd/voxland/security/advisories/new). Don't open a public issue or disclose it until we've had a reasonable chance to fix it.

Report vulnerabilities in Discord itself to [Discord](https://discord.com/security), and in Vencord or Vesktop to their maintainers.
